Live recheck at 12:45:59Z confirmed HTTP 404 on the direct probe URL, matching expectation. Distinct from the 2026-08-13 cycle 234-235 flap, which hit dialect:sdmx3 and errors:missing_artefact together as 503, not this assertion alone as 500. Also surfaced a monitor tooling gap: /api/history's per-cycle status computation (monitor/main.py api_history) does not pass contract rows into derive_status, so a contract-only degraded cycle like this one never shows up in the history series even though /api/status would have shown it live; flagged as a code-change-scope fix, not actioned here. Watch for a second occurrence of this specific assertion/status combination.
